problem_statement: getopt_long()/getopt_long_only() must accept an option argument written in the same argv entry as the option, in the form --option=argument (per the Linux man page). With the current implementation an argument attached with '=' is not recognized: the option name is compared against the whole '--option=argument' string and never matches, so the required/optional argument is not extracted and the test that supplies --OptionC=Arg1 and --OptionD=Arg2 reports the wrong optarg values. Make getopt_long()/getopt_long_only() parse the '=' form and return the trailing argument as optarg.
